NMT Green Ride 2026 is Campaign 01 of Green Mission India 360°. The ride ends in December; the mission keeps going.

A contemporary environmental movement

A greener India.
Grown together.

Green Mission India 360° connects people, plants, soil and communities through growing, conservation, restoration, education and collaboration, making environmental action part of everyday life in India.

Purpose

Bring people closer to nature and make greener living a shared responsibility.

Vision

A greener India where communities protect, grow and nurture their environment.

Mission

Make environmental action accessible through growing, learning and collaboration.

Brand essence: Growth through collective action.

Why this mission · The vision for Indore

From one household
to a greener city.
Then the country.

Small-space growing is a realistic start for city families.
Edible plants keep people involved long after a one-day planting drive.
Local voices, creators and radio keep people taking part.
Honest measurement turns inspiration into a model other cities can repeat.

Ambition: help make Indore one of India's greenest cities through verified household participation. Awards and official recognition are aspirations, not secured outcomes.

Home → City → Country

NMT Green Ride 2026
What happens at each stop

01 · Indore · Green House

Expedition flag-off

  • NMT Green Ride flag-off
  • Pan-India onboarding launch
  • NMT Home Kit & campaign brief
  • Convoy formation: cars left, bikes right
  • Media & community showcase

02 · Neemuch

Seeds & knowledge

  • Neembu, Mirchi, Tamatar seed sourcing
  • Seed quality, provenance & varieties
  • Germination & nursery training
  • Farmers & seed experts (Beej Pariwar)
  • Seed-to-home growing plan

03 · Mumbai

City campaign & creative capital

  • Celebrity & influencer green pledge
  • City rally (cars & bikes)
  • Public awareness events & media
  • Urban home-growing demo
  • “Three plants. One home.” mass campaign

04 · Hyderabad

DNG Grow 8+ & home growing

  • DNG Grow 8+ collection showcase
  • Masterclass: how to grow NMT at home
  • Balcony, terrace & backyard setup
  • Expert session: soil, pot, water & care
  • Community onboarding

05 · Coimbatore

Blessings & Save Soil*

  • Full convoy arrival at Isha Foundation
  • Seeking blessings & guidance from Sadhguru Ji
  • Save Soil initiative celebration
  • Deeper learning & guidance session
  • Inner & outer ecology: aligning action

06 · Indore

Grand homecoming & city rollout

  • Expedition completion & welcome rally
  • Save Soil & home-growing city campaign
  • Participant felicitation & impact sharing
  • Next phase: Indore green city rollout
  • “Let's create history and call it ART”
